title: Isoquercitrin inhibits ferroptosis and ameliorates insulin resistance: Evidence from network pharmacology and in vitro studies.
authors: Meng, Junyu; Hu, Changlong; Qian, Zhou; Yue, Jiakui; Zhang, Shengnan; Jiang, Wenyan; Su, Rui; Jiang, Guojun; Huang, Guihong
one_liner_zh: 该研究用网络药理学和分子对接研究异槲皮苷抑制铁死亡改善胰岛素抵抗，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to explore the potential targets and mechanisms by which Isoquercitrin inhibits ferroptosis to ameliorate insulin resistance (IR), using network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vitro assays. Targets related to Isoquercitrin, ferroptosis, and IR were retrieved from public databases and used to construct a Venn diagram. A protein-protein interaction network was constructed and visualized using Cytoscape. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analyses were conducted via the DAVID database and visualized with R Studio. Additionally, a drug-target-disease-pathway network was constructed using Cytoscape. GO enrichment analysis revealed key biological processes, cellular components, and molecular functions, while KEGG analysis indicated significant enrichment in the HIF-1alpha signaling pathway. Molecular docking showed that Isoquercitrin had a strong binding affinity to the core target HIF-1alpha, with a binding energy of -5.12 kcal/mol. For further validation, an in vitro IR model was established using two hepatocellular carcinoma cell lines, HepG2 and Huh-7. Isoquercitrin significantly enhanced cell viability and promoted glucose uptake in both cell lines. Western blot analysis showed that Isoquercitrin decreased the protein expression levels of HIF-1alpha and HO-1, while increasing the expression of the ferroptosis-related markers, including GPX4, SLC7A11, and FTH1. Furthermore, Isoquercitrin treatment reduced the levels of malondialdehyde, reactive oxygen species, and Fe(2+), while increasing glutathione levels. Moreover, co-treatment with Isoquercitrin and the HIF-1alpha inhibitor PX-478 further suppressed HIF-1alpha and HO-1 expression, highlighting Isoquercitrin's involvement in modulating the HIF-1alpha/HO-1 signaling pathway. These findings suggest that Isoquercitrin may ameliorate IR by inhibiting ferroptosis through regulation of the HIF-1alpha/HO-1 pathway. This study provides promising prospects for the clinical application of active compounds derived from traditional Chinese herbal medicines in IR treatment.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过网络药理学、分子对接及体外实验，探讨异槲皮苷（Isoquercitrin）抑制铁死亡（ferroptosis）以改善胰岛素抵抗（insulin resistance, IR）的潜在靶点与机制。从公共数据库中检索与异槲皮苷、铁死亡及IR相关的靶点，并用于构建韦恩图（Venn diagram）。利用Cytoscape构建并可视化蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络。通过DAVID数据库进行基因本体论（Gene Ontology, GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）通路分析，并使用R Studio进行可视化。此外，利用Cytoscape构建药物-靶点-疾病-通路网络。GO富集分析揭示了关键生物过程、细胞组分和分子功能，而KEGG分析显示在HIF-1α信号通路中显著富集。分子对接显示，异槲皮苷与核心靶点HIF-1α具有强结合亲和力，结合能为-5.12 kcal/mol。为进一步验证，使用两种肝细胞癌细胞系HepG2和Huh-7建立了体外IR模型。异槲皮苷显著增强了两种细胞系的细胞活力并促进了葡萄糖摄取。Western blot分析显示，异槲皮苷降低了HIF-1α和HO-1的蛋白表达水平，同时增加了铁死亡相关标志物（包括GPX4、SLC7A11和FTH1）的表达。此外，异槲皮苷处理降低了丙二醛、活性氧和Fe(2+)的水平，同时增加了谷胱甘肽水平。进一步地，异槲皮苷与HIF-1α抑制剂PX-478联合处理进一步抑制了HIF-1α和HO-1的表达，突显了异槲皮苷在调节HIF-1α/HO-1信号通路中的作用。这些发现表明，异槲皮苷可能通过调节HIF-1α/HO-1通路抑制铁死亡，从而改善IR。本研究为传统中草药活性化合物在IR治疗中的临床应用提供了有前景的前景。
